packageRules.description: Group all non-major npm dependency updates together

TypeScript major updates (e.g. the v7 Go-based compiler) change type-checking behavior across all packages: minor/patch updates flow as usual, majors require explicit approval on the dependency dashboard.

Major npm updates (material-ui v9, eslint v10, next major, ...) change code behavior and APIs: keep them visible on the dependency dashboard, but require explicit approval before a PR is opened. Minor/patch updates keep flowing as usual.
